wins: Goblins everywhere: token makers flood the board, Goblin Chieftain gives them all haste and +1/+1, and they swarm before the opponent stabilizes.
plan: Raging Goblin attacks immediately; Goblin Instigator makes two goblins.
Krenko’s Command and Hordeling Outburst add more goblins; Goblin Chieftain makes them all hasty and bigger. Borderland Marauder hits for 3 on attack.
Keldon Raider and Shivan Dragon close it out; Bolt and Searing Spear burn the last points.
keys: Other Goblins get +1/+1 and haste: cast it, then attack with everything.
Instant +3/+3: win a combat or push extra damage through.
Firebreathing flier: dump spare mana into it.
tips: Cast token makers before Chieftain when you can, so more goblins get the bonus.
Use burn on blockers early, the opponent’s face late.
Keldon Raider loots when it enters: discard extra lands late.
mulligan: Keep 2–4 Mountains with cheap goblins or token makers.
